'''Sokiro Terebin''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi artisan/Legends|artificer]] who at one point in history served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Among Terebin's contributions was the study of [[resonator]] technology on the planet [[Filata]]. During her studies, Terebin created crystalline resonators attuned to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] from [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] she unearthed at [[Site-145]]. The internal resonators she created were used to power and test the effectiveness of other ancient tech she unearthed. Only capable of being used by [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Forceful]] individuals, Terebin recorded in detail her findings on resonator technology and submitted her research to the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
